scripts.build: pnpm --filter @openhr/shared build && pnpm --filter @openhr/api build && pnpm --filter @openhr/web build
scripts.lint: node scripts/sync-onboarding.mjs --check && eslint apps packages scripts tests *.ts && prettier --check apps packages scripts tests *.ts package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.check.json eslint.config.mjs compose.yaml .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages scripts tests *.ts package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.check.json eslint.config.mjs compose.yaml .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @openhr/shared build && pnpm -r --filter "@openhr/*" typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.check.json
